_note: Net agricultural income, which the Finance Act brings into the rates (partial integration; W-258, C2a): FA 2026 s.2(2)(a) (TY 2025-26, p.2), "any net agricultural income exceeding five thousand rupees, in addition to the total income", and s.3(2)(a) (TY 2026-27, p.9), "any agricultural net income exceeding ₹ 5000" — the limit is the RS-RATE-AGRICULTURAL rows'. "Net agricultural income" is "the total amount of agricultural income, from whatever source derived, of that person computed in accordance with the rules contained in Part IV-A [IV-B] of the First Schedule" (s.2(7)(b), p.9; s.3(18)(c), p.29; Part IV-A p.101, Part IV-B p.104): the person computes it, as ITR-2 Schedule EI 2(iv) asks ("Gross Agricultural receipts" less "Expenditure incurred on agriculture" less "Unabsorbed agricultural loss of previous eight assessment years", "enter nil if loss"; Gazette CG-DL-E-30032026-271435). A separate question from AGRICULTURAL_INCOME, which r.164's bar reads ("agricultural income", not net). The wording is drafted by Claude and adopted by the owner (W-258 C2a, session 107). Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27, as AGRICULTURAL_INCOME (D-748 scope).
question: What was your net agricultural income for the tax year — gross agricultural receipts less agricultural expenditure and unabsorbed agricultural losses of the previous eight years, nil if a loss?
